headline: Four more banks in Uzbekistan granted licenses to carry out Islamic banking operations
summary: Under decisions taken on November 18, the central bank licensed Ipak Yo'li, Asia Alliance Bank, Orient Finans and Hayot Bank to conduct Islamic banking. The licences allow them to offer Sharia-compliant services.
why: Islamic banking licences expand the range of financing products in a market, drawing in new deposits and capital that follow Sharia-compliant rules.
original_headline: O‘zbekistonda yana to‘rtta bankka islomiy bank faoliyatini amalga oshirish uchun litsenziya berildi
